Economy · India

Indian Rupee Strengthens Against US Dollar

The Indian Rupee saw a significant appreciation, gaining 47 paise to reach 94.26 against the US dollar in early trade. This movement occurred while the dollar index, a measure of the US dollar's strength against six major currencies, was trading marginally lower by 0.16% at 99.43. The slight dip in the dollar index was attributed to safe-haven demand amidst renewed tensions between the US and Iran.
